cards.text: Tell me one tiny, unintentional thing I do that still makes you want to pull me closer.
Hold steady eye contact in complete silence for 45 seconds—let the eye contact stay as long as it feels good. Whoever breaks first owes a whispered confession.
What was the exact moment you knew the pull between us was different from anyone else?
Put on a slow song that feels like us—interlace your fingers and sway together for the first 20 seconds.
What quiet everyday moment with me makes your pulse soften the second it happens?
Which night we spent together still replays in your head like a favorite midnight scene?
Describe the chemistry between us in three words—then let your partner kiss you if they agree.
When you're exhausted at the end of a long day, what touch or gesture from me melts your tension fastest?
Flirt with your partner like it's the night we first met—30 seconds on the clock, and they decide if you won them over.
What secret first impression did you have of me that you were too shy to admit back then?
Pull your partner in for a 30-second slow dance with no music—hands stay on their waist, foreheads almost touching, no laughing allowed.
Invent a teasing secret nickname for your partner—you have to whisper it every time you speak to them tonight.
In a low, cinematic voice, spend 30 seconds describing your partner as the irresistible lead of a late-night romance.
If we could vanish to a hidden hotel balcony anywhere in the world tonight, where are we pouring our drinks?
Hand over tonight's soundtrack and drink order to your partner—no vetoes allowed.
Name two bold date nights we've only talked about—pick one tonight and promise a date on the calendar.
What quiet detail about my body or scent still pulls you toward me when nobody is looking?
Rest your foreheads together and synchronize your breathing for 40 seconds — hands locked around each other's waist.
Confess a private moment you secretly replayed in your head long after we went to sleep.
Trace the outline of your partner's jawline, lips, and neck with one fingertip for 45 seconds without speaking.
What is one unspoken compliment about how I feel in your arms that you have never said out loud?
Kiss your partner's inner wrist, palm, and fingertips slowly for 30 seconds while holding intense eye contact.
When we are alone at night, what subtle cue tells you I am completely in the mood for you?
Sit knee-to-knee for 45 seconds and take turns naming one secret reason you still crave the other.
Brush your warm breath from behind your partner's ear down to their collarbone for 35 seconds without letting your lips touch.
What is the boldest thought you have ever had about me somewhere that feels like ours alone?
Your partner closes their eyes for 45 seconds: guide their fingertips to three spots on your body you want kissed later.
Pull your partner onto your lap facing you and hold a 30-second breathless forehead-to-forehead stare — no kissing yet.
Which piece of my clothing makes you want to peel it off me the fastest?
Keep both hands behind your back for 40 seconds while your partner explores your neck and jawline with only their lips.
Stand close behind your partner, wrap your arms around their waist, and sway slowly while whispering what you love touching most (45s).
If you could freeze time for 15 minutes right now, what is the very first naughty thing you would do to me?
For 45 seconds, whisper a velvet bedtime story starring the two of us checking into a hidden penthouse suite.
Place five agonizingly slow kisses anywhere between your partner's ear and shoulder blade (30s).
"Be honest, don't blush…" What quiet compliment about me crossed your mind the second you saw me today?
"Don't look away…" Lean in till our noses almost touch for 35s—first one to blush owes a slow kiss.
"Give me your hand…" Lace our fingers, trace my palm with your thumb for 30s, then press a shy kiss to my wrist.
"Tipsy truth time…" Take a slow sip and tell me which sleepy or tipsy side of me makes you melt.
"Watch me while you sip…" Clink glasses, take a sip without breaking eye contact, then softly brush my lower lip.
"Tell me secretly…" When did the way I said your name make your heart skip and your ears go warm?
"Come hide in my arms…" Rest against my chest listening to my heartbeat for 40s, then leave a soft kiss on my jaw.
"No giggling…" Trace my brow, nose, and lips with one fingertip for 30s, lingering shyly on my bottom lip.
"Shy confession…" Holding hands in a crowded cinema or street, have you ever secretly wanted to pull me into a quiet corner?
"Close your eyes for me…" I'll leave 3 feather-soft kisses near your cheek, brow, and mouth—guess which came closest.
"Just between us…" Which scent on me—my shampoo, skin, or collar—instantly makes you want to pull me close?
"Let's invent our secret code…" Pick a shy two-word signal that means 'I really want to kiss you right now.'
"Turn around for me…" Wrap your arms around my waist from behind and whisper one sweet craving behind my ear (35s).
"Look in my eyes and answer…" If you could only kiss one spot on me all night, which would you pick and why?
"Cheers—tonight is yours…" Clink glasses, take a sip, and let me set the lighting and how close you sit for 10 minutes.
"Pretend we're only a week into crushing…" Tell me shyly, 'I don't really want you to go home tonight.'
"Don't blink…" Cup my cheek warmly and brush my lower lip with your thumb for 30s until I lean in first.
"Whisper it softly…" When we're tangled up right before sleep, what's the last thought about me in your head?
"Hold still for me…" Curl onto my lap and breathe warm air 1 cm from my earlobe for 35s—no soft kiss yet!
"No dodging…" When did you watch me just getting dressed or drying my hair and suddenly get wicked thoughts?
"Can you hold back?" Press foreheads together with our lips half a centimeter apart for 30s—first to kiss loses!
"Let me take one shy soft kiss…" soft kiss my fingertip or lower lip, then immediately soothe it with soft kisses (25s).
"Taste if it's sweet…" Take a tiny sip of your drink, lean in, and share the warmth with a slow kiss.
"Eyes shut, hands behind your back…" I'll press 4 secret kisses over 40s—whisper which spot tickled most.
"Pretend I'm your secret crush who snuck over…" Confess nervously for 40s, then press my hand over your heartbeat.
"Naughty question…" If an empty elevator paused for 3 minutes with just us, what's the boldest thing you'd do?
"Pinky promise…" On our next night out, pull me into a quiet corner and steal a breathless 5-second kiss.
"Help me out…" let the eye contact stay as long as it feels good, slowly undo a cuff, remove an accessory, or slip my collar aside and kiss the skin.
"Be good, hands still…" Gently pin my wrist against the couch for 30s while kissing my brows, nose, and earlobe.
"Tipsy confession…" Have you ever pretended to be a little tipsier than you were just to lean into my arms?
"Come here, let me warm you…" Rub your palms warm and trace slow circles on my lower back for 40s.
"Stay in character…" Flirt with me like we just met in a dim lounge—3 low-voiced lines until I pull you in.
"Don't be shy…" Do my slow, teasing kisses undo you faster, or the sudden, breathless ones?
"Don't shy away…" Breathe warmly into my collarbone hollow and linger with soft kisses for 30s.
"Close your eyes and listen…" In the dim light, whisper 3 irresistible details about me you've never said aloud.
"Secret tease pact…" Next time we sit side-by-side somewhere that feels like ours alone, slip your fingers into mine and tickle my palm with a poker face.
"Your hands are chilly…" Cup my hands in yours, warm them gently for 30s, then press them to my cheeks.
"Tuck my hair back…" Brush hair behind my ear and let your fingertips linger along my cheek (30s).
"Let me recharge on your shoulder…" Lean close swaying softly for 35s, nuzzling gently against my neck.
"Guess what I'm writing on your palm…" Trace a shy 3-letter word slowly on my palm—guess right for a sweet kiss (25s).
"Lean down for a second…" Cup my face and press four feather-soft kisses on my brow, temples, and nose (35s).
"Hold still for me…" Trace gently near the corner of my mouth while listening to our hearts race (30s).
"Hold me tighter…" Pull me flush against you for 40s, smoothing warm palms from upper back down to my waist.
"Warm up under the throw…" Tangle our feet under the blanket while massaging my palms and sharing a shy compliment (35s).
